basic_details.job_title: Delhi Archaeology Department Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 JRF, SRF Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Archaeology (Puratattva Vibhag), Government of N.C.T. of Delhi offers 12 one-year research fellowships: 3 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 3 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in Archaeology, and 3 SRF and 3 JRF in Conservation, all unreserved (UR). SRF pays Rs. 50,000 and JRF Rs. 25,000 per month, and applicants must be up to 40 years of age. SRF needs a PhD and JRF a Masters in the subject. The application form is available at the department or on its website, and the application must reach the department within 30 days of publication of the advertisement – about 11 December 2026

how_to_apply: The application is made on the department's application form, which must reach the Department of Archaeology within 30 days of publication of the advertisement – about 11 December 2026 (30 days from 11 November 2026). The notice does not specify whether the form is to be sent by post or delivered by hand.
Collect the application form and the requisite terms and conditions from the Department of Archaeology, or download them from https://archaeology.delhi.gov.in/latest-news.
Fill in the form for the field (Archaeology or Conservation) and the fellowship (SRF or JRF) you are eligible for.
Make sure the application reaches the department at 2nd Floor, B-Block, Vikas Bhawan-II, M.G. Road, Civil Lines, Delhi-110054 within 30 days of publication of the advertisement.
For queries, the department gives the email [email protected] and the phone number 011-23814026.
important_instructions: The requisite terms and conditions of the fellowship are available at the department and on its website, along with the application form. The notice says the application must reach the department within the 30-day period, so the date of receipt counts.

Department of Archaeology, Civil Lines, Delhi

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The department offers 12 fellowships in total: 6 in Archaeology and 6 in Conservation. Every fellowship is for the unreserved (UR) category, and each runs for 1 year.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The eligible age for all four fellowships is up to 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Those who are presently receiving a fellowship from the Central or State Government are not eligible. The notice does not mention experience or NET/GATE for any of the fellowships. Candidates should check the official notification and the department's terms and conditions for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many fellowships are offered in Delhi Archaeology Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 fellowships: 3 SRF and 3 JRF in Archaeology, and 3 SRF and 3 JRF in Conservation, all in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Delhi Archaeology SRF and JRF fellowships?
faq.answer: The application must reach the department within 30 days of publication of the advertisement, which is about 11 December 2026 (30 days from 11 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SRF fellowships?
faq.answer: SRF Archaeology needs a PhD in Ancient Indian History, Culture & Archaeology/History, and SRF Conservation needs a PhD in Conservation, Preservation or Heritage Management; a related Post Graduate Diploma is desirable for both.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the JRF fellowships?
faq.answer: JRF Archaeology needs a Masters in Ancient/Medieval Indian History or a Masters in Archaeology. JRF Conservation needs a Masters in Conservation, Preservation and Heritage Management or a Masters in Conservation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Delhi Archaeology fellowships?
faq.answer: Candidates for all four fellowships must be up to 40 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The SRF amount is Rs. 50,000/- per month and the JRF amount is Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the fellowship?
faq.answer: Each SRF and JRF fellowship is for a period of 1 year.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The application form and terms and conditions are available at the Department of Archaeology or can be downloaded from https://archaeology.delhi.gov.in/latest-news.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate already receiving a government fellowship apply?
faq.answer: No. Those who are presently receiving a fellowship from the Central or State Government are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Are any fellowships reserved for SC, ST or OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No. All 12 fellowships are shown as UR (unreserved) in the advertisement.
